node.title: Rank-eleven rank-nine cells have an exact split-pencil ledger
node.closure: affine owner-plane classification, pairwise-balanced record-line design, disjoint petal charge, and fixed-cell cap
node.statement: For records assigned to one fixed rank-nine ten-coordinate cell B, all pair owners agreeing with the received pair on B form an affine plane. A slope gamma gives a record line of direction (-gamma*u,u), and distinct record lines meet in one owner, yielding sum_p C(t_p,2)=C(g,2). Owner cores split into one common root core J_B and pairwise disjoint off-root petals. At least 45153 petal-extension incidences per record, fixed-owner multiplicity at most 981105, and total petal size at most 2097152-10 imply the sharp integer cap g<=45567658. Cross-cell aggregation remains open.
